value.rationale: Sharp paired c=1/3 and c=2/3 cutoffs on the smallest frustrated nonbipartite spin graph identify an exact physically meaningful region of entanglement certified by the conjunction of frustrated ground energy and identical measured transverse marginals. They distinguish classical correlated ground mixtures from coherent ground superpositions and directly address the fixed-marginal optimization gap left by ferromagnetic/two-colorable results. It is not proposed as a new energy value, field phase diagram, or merely a normalization test.
